newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura Color says acquired Netherlands' Bruynzeel.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Color says acquired Netherlands' Bruynzeel.

text.p: Sakura Color Products Corp said on Wednesday that its wholly owned unit had acquired Bruynzeel Potlodenfabriek Beheer BV of the Netherlands.

The major Japanese maker of pastels and other colouring and drawing products declined to comment on the value of the acquisition. A Sakura official said the Dutch firm has a 60 percent share of the Benelux pencil market.
Bruynzeel makes and sells pencils and other stationery.
Sakura expects the acquisition to help it to further expand globally, particularly in Europe, the official said.
Sakura also hopes to strengthen its product lines by using Bruynzeel's technology, he said.
In 1991, Sakura acquired Dutch drawing materials maker Royal Talens.
